name: Kashmir in Autumn Colours
route: Srinagar · Pampore · Pahalgam · Achabal · Kokernag · Gulmarg
description: City gardens, mountain light, and a gentle seasonal valley circuit.

itinerary.title: Lake light and a garden afternoon
itinerary.description: Settle into Srinagar before choosing one Mughal garden for the afternoon. Nishat and a Dal-side walk make a gentle first introduction without crossing the city repeatedly. If your arrival is early enough, request a shikara towards evening; a late flight simply means a quieter welcome and the lake visit moves to another day. Leave the old-city walk for its own day so there is time to enjoy it.
places: Nishat Bagh: terraces and chinar shade, subject to opening
Dal Lake boulevard: an easy waterfront stroll
experiences: An evening shikara requested in the quote
Kahwa after the journey, with time to settle in
itinerary.meals: Dinner, if included in your quote

itinerary.title: Across the saffron country
itinerary.description: Travel south through Pampore before continuing towards Pahalgam. Choose a pre-arranged grower conversation or the Awantipora heritage stop rather than treating every roadside stop as compulsory. A farm visit depends on a willing host; saffron flowers, apple picking and harvest activity cannot be promised for every autumn date. Reach Pahalgam with daylight left for a first walk beside the Lidder.
places: Pampore: cultivation stories with a participating grower
Awantipora: an optional heritage pause on the onward route
Lidder riverbank: an evening walk near the stay
experiences: A seasonal grower visit arranged ahead
A local lunch requested separately, with dietary preferences discussed
itinerary.meals: Breakfast & dinner proposed; hosted lunch only if confirmed
itinerary.routeNote: Choose the stops that fit daylight, local access and your pace. Optional activities and detours require a confirmed quote.

itinerary.title: Choose your own Pahalgam pace
itinerary.description: Give the Pahalgam surroundings a full day. Choose Aru for village and meadow time, or combine a shorter Aru visit with Betaab if local transport and daylight allow. Travellers who prefer fewer transfers can stay longer in one valley and return for tea beside the river. Pony activities are optional, separately agreed and dependent on a suitable operator; walking is a complete experience in its own right.
experiences: Valley walks at your own pace
Optional pony activity with terms agreed first
itinerary.routeNote: Choose the stops that fit daylight, local access and your pace. Optional activities and detours require a confirmed quote.

itinerary.title: Achabal and the southern springs
itinerary.description: Leave Pahalgam for a considered southern-valley return. Request Achabal and Kokernag as the main garden stops, with an early start and enough time for lunch before continuing to Srinagar. Verinag can replace a stop if the driver confirms a workable day. Daksum is better treated as an extra-night extension rather than another compulsory detour on this transfer.
places: Achabal: a spring-fed garden stop on the selected return route
Kokernag: garden paths and spring surroundings
Verinag: an alternative stop, not a promised third excursion
experiences: A slower garden walk between road stages
A lunch break planned before the return to Srinagar
itinerary.routeNote: Choose the stops that fit daylight, local access and your pace. Optional activities and detours require a confirmed quote.

itinerary.title: Mountain light in Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Take the Tangmarg approach to Gulmarg, allowing a tea break before the climb. At Gulmarg, choose a lower meadow walk or a ticketed Gondola outing, depending on weather and your interests. The final quote must identify any Gondola phase and local vehicle charges. Return with a sensible daylight buffer rather than adding another distant valley to the same day.
places: Gulmarg: meadow or snow-appropriate lower paths
experiences: A forest-edge walk matched to conditions
Gondola only when the phase and tickets have been confirmed
itinerary.routeNote: Choose the stops that fit daylight, local access and your pace. Optional activities and detours require a confirmed quote.

itinerary.title: Srinagar through local eyes
itinerary.description: Spend the day close to Srinagar instead of adding another long drive. Request a locally guided walk around the Jhelum-side old city, allowing time for architecture, a bakery stop and a craft demonstration arranged with a willing artisan. Choose Nigeen-side quiet time or a Dal outing later. Dachigam may replace the city programme if permissions are confirmed; it is not automatically added to an already full day.
places: Jhelum-side old city: a guide-selected walking route
An artisan workspace: by appointment and permission
Nigeen or Dal: choose a relaxed lakeside finish
experiences: A bakery and kahwa stop with dietary needs discussed
A craft demonstration without an obligation to shop

itinerary.title: One more valley morning
itinerary.description: Keep your final morning flexible around your flight. A brief lakefront stop or time for shopping may fit before the arranged transfer. Confirm pickup time and allow a generous buffer for traffic and airport procedures.
experiences: A relaxed breakfast when departure timing allows
A short final stop only if the transfer buffer is protected
itinerary.routeNote: Departure timing takes priority. Extra stops are only considered after allowing a transfer buffer.

extensions.title: One more Pahalgam valley day
extensions.description: Request two nights for a slower Pahalgam stay, choosing Aru or Betaab on separate outings rather than rushing both. This may change the main route; local transport, entry charges, hotel and extra cost are quoted separately.

extensions.title: Southern springs with an overnight
extensions.description: Discuss a separate Kokernag or Daksum-area night so the southern valley has its own time. The overnight base, road access, heating and return route need confirmation rather than being added to a busy transfer day.

extensions.title: Srinagar heritage, museum and craft time
extensions.description: Add a separate city day for SPS Museum and one appointed carpet, weaving or traditional-art visit, or a focused shrine-and-market walk. Opening, worship, host participation and all fees must be confirmed.
